operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: 422 Flotilla Activists Arrive in Turkey; Netanyahu Rebukes Ben-Gvir; EU Sanctions Discussions Begin — Day 954
heroSubtitle: On Day 954 of the Gaza war (May 22, 2026), 422 Global Sumud Flotilla activists — including 85 Turkish nationals — arrived in Turkey after Israel's mass deportation operation. Activists reported abuse in Israeli custody including rubber bullets, punching, and transport in leg chains. Italian Prime Minister called for EU-level sanctions discussions against National Security Minister Ben-Gvir, while Prime Minister Netanyahu publicly stated Ben-Gvir's conduct in posting taunting videos of bound detainees was 'not in line with Israel's values.' Multiple countries summoned Israeli ambassadors. IDF airstrikes continued in central and southern Gaza on Day 12 of the renewed military campaign. Gaza's cumulative death toll surpasses 73,800 confirmed killed since October 7, 2023.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, Haaretz, Al Arabiya, Euronews, Washington Post, WAFA, IMEMC, NBC News, Middle East Eye, OHCHR, The National, Long War Journal. Gaza death toll: 73,800+ confirmed killed since Oct 7, 2023. Day 954 (May 22): 422 flotilla activists arrive in Turkey; Italy pushes EU sanctions against Ben-Gvir; Netanyahu rebukes Ben-Gvir; IDF strikes continue central Gaza. Day 953 (May 21): ~430 flotilla activists deported; Ben-Gvir taunting video triggers diplomatic crisis; IDF strikes Al-Maghazi, Hamas Nukhba operative killed; Hamas-BoP talks impasse. Day 951 (May 19): ICC seeks Smotrich arrest warrant; 41 flotilla boats intercepted, 10 FM joint condemnation. Day 949 (May 17): Bahaa Baroud killed; Hamas names Khalil al-Hayya new Gaza leader. Day 948 (May 16): Izz al-Din al-Haddad killed. Day 945 (May 13): Mohammed Sinwar killed. UNRWA staff killed: 391. IDF security cabinet authorized war resumption May 10, 2026. Orange Line = 64%+ of Gaza Strip.
